name: Airtable
label: Airtable Web API
description: Airtable Web API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/airtable/api_spec.json). Official Airtable Web API. Legacy API keys retired — use PAT or OAuth access token. Rate limits apply. ToS bars scraping. Official docs: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Airtable official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'create', 'list', 'get', 'update', 'upsert', 'delete', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'create'.

schema.label: base_id
schema.description: Airtable base id path (app…). Required for every HTTP op. Example: appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.

schema.label: table_id
schema.description: Table id or name path (tbl… or the table name). Required for every HTTP op. Example: tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Airtable field name → value map for create and update (POST/PATCH record). Example: {"Name":"Ada","Status":"Active"}. Keep as the official write body; list-column filter is not this field.

schema.label: typecast
schema.description: Coerce string values to the field type on create/update. Example: true.

schema.label: maxRecords
schema.description: Max records to return on list. Example: 100.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: List pagination offset token from the previous response.

schema.label: filterByFormula
schema.description: Airtable formula filter for list. Example: {Status}='Active'.

schema.label: view
schema.description: View name or id for list. Example: Grid view.

schema.label: record_id
schema.description: Record id path (rec…) for get / update / delete. Example: recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.

schema.label: performUpsert
schema.description: Upsert options for upsert. Official: {fieldsToMergeOn: ["Email"]}. Example: {"fieldsToMergeOn":["Email"]}.

schema.label: records
schema.description: Record array for upsert: [{id?, fields}]. Used with performUpsert. Example: [{"fields":{"Email":"ada@example.com","Name":"Ada"}}].

schema.label: pageSize
schema.description: List page size 1–100 (official pageSize query). Example: 50.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: List sort: [{field, direction}]. direction asc|desc. Example: [{"field":"Name","direction":"asc"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: create, list, get, update, upsert, delete, listen. Default: create. Example: create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_key). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Base Id
configurationParameters.description: Default Airtable base id (app…) when INPUT base_id is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Table Id
configurationParameters.description: Default table id or name when INPUT table_id is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Typecast
configurationParameters.description: Coerce string values to the field type on create/update. Example: true.

configurationParameters.label: Fields
configurationParameters.description: Airtable field name → value map for create and update (POST/PATCH record). Example: {"Name":"Ada","Status":"Active"}. Keep as the official write body; list-column filter is not this field.

configurationParameters.label: Maxrecords
configurationParameters.description: Max records to return on list. Example: 100.

configurationParameters.label: Sort
configurationParameters.description: List sort: [{field, direction}]. direction asc|desc. Example: [{"field":"Name","direction":"asc"}].

configurationParameters.label: Offset
configurationParameters.description: List pagination offset token from the previous response.

configurationParameters.label: Filterbyformula
configurationParameters.description: Airtable formula filter for list. Example: {Status}='Active'.

configurationParameters.label: Pagesize
configurationParameters.description: List page size 1–100 (official pageSize query). Example: 50.

configurationParameters.label: View
configurationParameters.description: View name or id for list. Example: Grid view.

configurationParameters.label: Record ID
configurationParameters.description: Record id path (rec…) for get / update / delete. Example: recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.

configurationParameters.label: Records
configurationParameters.description: Record array for upsert: [{id?, fields}]. Used with performUpsert. Example: [{"fields":{"Email":"ada@example.com","Name":"Ada"}}].

configurationParameters.label: Performupsert
configurationParameters.description: Upsert options for upsert. Official: {fieldsToMergeOn: ["Email"]}. Example: {"fieldsToMergeOn":["Email"]}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
